# Will your bees pay for themselves?

> Free beekeeping profit calculator. Project colonies, honey, nuc sales and pollination income year by year; see winter-loss sensitivity, break-even hives and payback. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
